usage.summary:
Implemented recoverable repair and merge outcomes, CI invalidation, deferred resume, external settlement and stale-outcome guards. Updated contracts, explorer and README; preserved ratified definitions.

Full gate passed on run 3: 20,889 states, all witnesses, properties, counterexamples, proofs and build checks.

Watcher integration remains future work.

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The workflow starts in Init and advances only through Next steps.

pins.name: MergeRequiresCurrentCI
pins.says: The factory merges a follow-up only with passing CI for its current contents.

pins.name: OneFollowup
pins.says: A plan's decision obligation produces at most one follow-up pull request.

pins.name: RepairAllowance
pins.says: The factory uses at most two automatic repairs in each allowance.

pins.name: HumanHoldRespected
pins.says: Closure, exhausted repairs and definitive merge refusal hold the same follow-up for a person, and observations and in-flight outcomes preserve that hold until an authorized retry or resume is applied or the PR is confirmed merged.

pins.name: CurrentCIResults
pins.says: A completed CI result always describes the follow-up's current contents.

pins.name: AllowanceAccounting
pins.says: Only a repair consumes the repair allowance, and only an explicit retry or resume resets it.

pins.name: DeferredResumeSafety
pins.says: Resumption requested during an unresolved effect is remembered without releasing closure or renewing repairs and is applied only after that effect is reconciled as unmerged.

pins.name: OutcomeGuards
pins.says: Only an unresolved executed operation with the matching identity, kind, authorized revision and actual result can accept a completion, and an overtaken publication cannot overwrite the observed head.

pins.name: RepairFailureIsSeparate
pins.says: A failed or unchanged repair settles its attempt, records its execution outcome and cause separately, and preserves the observed head, CI and conflict instead of inventing a CI result or run.

pins.name: EffectRunsOnce
pins.says: An authorized effect executes at most once, and a lost reply retains the same operation and outcome for reconciliation.

pins.name: MergeAuthorizationIsPending
pins.says: Merge authorization requires current passing CI and no conflict or hold and remains nonterminal until the remote outcome is confirmed.

pins.name: MergeRefusalIsTruthful
pins.says: A definitive merge refusal preserves observed facts and closure, and an otherwise ready unchanged PR waits in a merge-refused hold for an explicit retry.

pins.name: ExternalSettlementHonest
pins.says: An externally merged PR is settled as external without inventing CI, changing repair usage or applying a deferred resumption.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every workflow value stays within its declared type.

pins.name: OnlyOwedMergedPlans
pins.says: Decision work starts only after the plan's pull request merges and only if the plan owes a decision.

pins.name: StableFollowupIdentity
pins.says: Creation, repairs, retries and resumption all refer to the same follow-up pull request.

pins.name: DraftUsesEvidence
pins.says: The drafting agent uses the plan, merged change and review as the decision's sources.

pins.name: DecisionClassification
pins.says: The decision is decided by agent exactly when the agent infers that an executed two-way door needs no owner input, and is proposed otherwise.

pins.name: FollowupHasDecision
pins.says: Every created follow-up contains a drafted decision classified as decided or proposed.

pins.name: DecisionCommandUsed
pins.says: The follow-up records its decision by running invariant decisions decide.

pins.name: JournalAndLogAgree
pins.says: The follow-up contains both a journal entry and its log row for the same new decision.

pins.name: CitationsCoverChangedText
pins.says: Every SPEC line and README passage written by the merged change cites the new decision in the follow-up.

pins.name: SpecIsRolledUp
pins.says: The follow-up includes the SPEC roll-up.

pins.name: FollowupScope
pins.says: The follow-up and all its repairs change only decisions/, SPEC.md and the README.

pins.name: MergeWithoutConflict
pins.says: The factory merges a follow-up only when it has no merge conflict.

pins.name: EachRepairStartsFreshCI
pins.says: A published repair invalidates prior CI and requires fresh CI for its new revision without charging the attempt again.

pins.name: RequestsRenewAllowance
pins.says: An applied explicit authorized retry or resume renews the allowance to two repairs, with resumption deferred while an earlier effect is unresolved.

pins.name: ExhaustionIsBlocked
pins.says: An exhausted follow-up has used both repairs and remains blocked even if later observations invalidate its earlier CI failure.

pins.name: DecidedDecisionMerged
pins.says: An executed two-way door inferred to need no owner input can be recorded as decided by agent and merged.

pins.name: OneWayProposedMerged
pins.says: A one-way door can be recorded as proposed and merged.

pins.name: OwnerInputProposedMerged
pins.says: An executed two-way door needing owner input can be recorded as proposed and merged.

pins.name: UnexecutedProposedMerged
pins.says: A two-way door that was not executed can be recorded as proposed and merged.

pins.name: NoDecisionWork
pins.says: A plan can merge without creating a follow-up when it owes no decision.

pins.name: DraftRetried
pins.says: The factory can automatically retry a failed drafting attempt.

pins.name: CreationRetried
pins.says: The factory can automatically retry a failed follow-up creation attempt.

pins.name: RepairCanMerge
pins.says: A repaired follow-up can pass fresh CI and merge.

pins.name: RepairsExhausted
pins.says: A follow-up can exhaust both repairs and block for a person.

pins.name: PersonRenewsExhaustedWork
pins.says: A person can retry an exhausted follow-up with two fresh repairs available.

pins.name: ClosedFollowupWaits
pins.says: A person can close the follow-up and leave its decision obligation waiting for explicit resumption.

pins.name: ResumeRenewsUnusedRepairs
pins.says: Resuming a follow-up closed after one repair can restore two available repairs.

pins.name: ResumeRenewsExhaustedRepairs
pins.says: Resuming a follow-up closed after both repairs can restore two available repairs.

pins.name: DraftProgress
pins.says: An eligible merged plan or a failed drafting attempt eventually starts a drafting attempt.

pins.name: CreationProgress
pins.says: A completed draft or a failed creation attempt eventually starts a follow-up creation attempt.

pins.name: RepairProgress
pins.says: A follow-up needing repair with allowance available eventually authorizes an attempt unless a hold, external settlement or changed observations remove the need.

pins.name: BlockingProgress
pins.says: A follow-up needing repair with no allowance eventually blocks unless it is closed, externally settled or no longer needs repair.

pins.name: MergeProgress
pins.says: A follow-up that remains ready to merge eventually authorizes a merge attempt without promising a remote success.

pins.name: DraftFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually starts a drafting attempt whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: CreationFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually starts a creation attempt whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: RepairFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually authorizes an available repair whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: BlockingFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually blocks exhausted work whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: MergeFairness

pins.name: MergeBeforeCI
pins.says: The factory incorrectly merges while the current CI run is still pending.

pins.name: CreateDuplicate

pins.name: RepairPastAllowance

pins.name: ResumeWithoutPerson

pins.name: DecideOneWay

pins.name: RepairAuthorizationCharged
pins.says: Each newly authorized repair consumes exactly one repair before execution, including an attempt that later fails or produces no publishable change.

pins.name: RepairFailureRemainsActionable
pins.says: An unresolved repair execution failure remains eligible for repair or exhaustion rather than waiting for CI that was never requested.

pins.name: RevisionInvalidatesCI
pins.says: Observing a new revision invalidates prior CI without consuming or renewing repairs or lifting a hold.

pins.name: TruthfulFollowupState
pins.says: An unmerged follow-up reports its current hold, unresolved effect or observed repair need truthfully.

pins.name: StableOperationIdentity
pins.says: Every repair or merge authorization gets a new stable operation identity tied to its revision, and execution, reconciliation and rejection preserve that identity.

pins.name: RejectedOutcomesPreserveState
pins.says: Rejecting a stale CI or effect outcome preserves the observed head, CI, conflict, allowance, hold and current operation.

pins.name: FactoryMergeConfirmed
pins.says: A factory-merged follow-up has a confirmed successful remote outcome for its authorized operation and revision.

pins.name: CIPendingWasRequested
pins.says: Pending CI names the current revision and never counts as a completed fresh result.

pins.name: FailedRepairRetainsConflict
pins.says: An agent failure can consume a repair while preserving passing CI and the real merge conflict.

pins.name: NoChangeRetainsCIFailure
pins.says: A repair with no publishable change can consume a repair and retain the real failing CI result.

pins.name: FailedRepairsExhaust
pins.says: Failed repair execution can exhaust both repairs and wait for a person.

pins.name: NoChangeRepairsExhaust
pins.says: Repairs with no publishable change can exhaust both repairs and wait for a person.

pins.name: FailureAllowanceRenewed
pins.says: A person can explicitly renew the allowance after unsuccessful repair execution exhausts it.

pins.name: PublishedRepairInvalidatesCI
pins.says: A published repair can leave its new revision awaiting a fresh CI request with its prior CI invalidated.

pins.name: HeadMovesAfterPassingCI
pins.says: A head change after passing CI can invalidate that result before merging.

pins.name: RevisionKeepsExhaustionHold
pins.says: A head change can invalidate CI while preserving the exhausted allowance and human hold.

pins.name: MergeAuthorizationPending
pins.says: An accepted merge authorization can remain pending before any remote merge has completed.

pins.name: ClosedMergeRefused
pins.says: Closure during an authorized merge can survive a definitive refusal.

pins.name: ConflictedMergeRefused
pins.says: A merge refused after a conflict appears can return to needing repair without fabricating failed CI.

pins.name: MovedHeadMergeRefused
pins.says: A merge refused after head movement can return to the observed new head with invalidated CI.

pins.name: CleanMergeRefused
pins.says: A same-head merge refusal with passing CI and no conflict can wait for an explicit human retry.

pins.name: PersonRetriesRefusedMerge
pins.says: A person can release a merge-refused hold with an explicit retry and a fresh repair allowance.

pins.name: LostRepairReconciled
pins.says: A lost repair reply can be reconciled without executing or charging the attempt twice.

pins.name: LostMergeReconciled
pins.says: A successful remote merge with a lost reply can be reconciled as factory-merged.

pins.name: DeferredResumeWaits
pins.says: An explicit resume can wait behind an unresolved effect while retaining the closure hold and spent allowance.

pins.name: DeferredResumeApplied
pins.says: A remembered resume can automatically apply once reconciliation confirms the PR is still unmerged.

pins.name: DeferredResumeSettledExternally
pins.says: External settlement can cancel a remembered resume without renewing the allowance or reopening the PR.

pins.name: ExternalMergeWithoutPassingCI
pins.says: An external merge can settle a follow-up without supplying an invented passing CI result.

pins.name: OldOperationOutcomeRejected
pins.says: A completion for an older operation can be rejected while a newer operation remains active.

pins.name: OldCIOutcomeRejected
pins.says: A CI result for an older revision can be rejected after head movement.

pins.name: SupersededRepairReconciled
pins.says: A repair publication overtaken by head movement can be reconciled without overwriting the observed head.

pins.name: DeferredResumeProgress
pins.says: Once reconciliation leaves a deferred resume on an unmerged PR, the request eventually applies unless the PR is externally settled.

pins.name: CIRequestProgress
pins.says: An unheld follow-up needing CI eventually requests it if no unresolved effect or repair need intervenes.

pins.name: DeferredResumeFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually applies a remembered resume whenever reconciliation leaves that step enabled.

pins.name: CIRequestFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually requests CI for a revision whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: RevisionRenewsAllowance

pins.name: ExternalMergeInventsCI

usage.summary:
I found two problems that can hide implementation errors from the gate.

- [followup/explore.go:179](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-2891952754/followup/explore.go:179): `after` discards the returned workflow whenever `ran` is false and reports the original state. A refused call that incorrectly returns changed state would therefore appear harmless.

- [followup/explore.go:114](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-2891952754/followup/explore.go:114): `workflow()` reconstructs `RepairLimit` from `RepairsPerRequest`, while `copyWorkflow` never preserves or checks the returned limit. An incorrect allowance from `New`, or a transition that changes it, gets silently corrected before the next call, concealing allowance-enforcement bugs.

review.text:
I found two problems that can hide implementation errors from the gate.

- [followup/explore.go:179](explore.go:179): `after` discards the returned workflow whenever `ran` is false and reports the original state. A refused call that incorrectly returns changed state would therefore appear harmless.

- [followup/explore.go:114](explore.go:114): `workflow()` reconstructs `RepairLimit` from `RepairsPerRequest`, while `copyWorkflow` never preserves or checks the returned limit. An incorrect allowance from `New`, or a transition that changes it, gets silently corrected before the next call, concealing allowance-enforcement bugs.
